Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged 3, cleared 5.
Flagged:
- r05 (summary_outlier): the REGR peak is 52.89 %/h against a batch median of 0.37. The growth zone is 695 µm against 42. The largest flank difference is -9.88 %/h against 0.55. The peak position is also off, so the strain-rate profile has a different shape. This is not just a faster root.
- r06 and r08 (summary_outlier): the largest flank difference sits at 84 µm against a median of 316 µm (z -5.05) and has the opposite sign (-0.47 vs 0.55 %/h). The REGR peak is also about twice the median (0.72 vs 0.37 %/h). The peak position and growth-zone length match the batch, but the flank-difference profile has a different shape.
Cleared: r01, r02, r03, r04 and r07. All checks pass, no remedies were kept, there were no roll backs, and every summary is close to the batch (largest |z| is about 1.4).
What the flagged runs have in common: all three checks passed, with no remedies and no roll backs. They are flagged only because their strain-rate or flank-difference (curvature-rate) profiles look unlike the rest of the batch. Passing checks did not catch these profile faults.
